description: Conservation profile of DYF-3 across 18 ciliated-species orthologues and interface enrichment test
code:
exec(open("helper.py").read())
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
d=pd.read_csv("DYF3_per_residue_conservation.csv")
tab=pd.read_json("ift38_interface_mapped_to_DYF3.json")
ift80=set(tab[tab.partner=="IFT80 (CHE-2)"].iloc[0].DYF3_res)
hi=d[(d["cons"]>=0.9)&(d["cov"]>=14)]
print("n positions >=90% identity across 18 orthologues:", len(hi))
print("  in CH 1-115:", int((hi.pos<=115).sum()), " in 116-300:", int(((hi.pos>115)&(hi.pos<=300)).sum()), " in 301-404:", int((hi.pos>300).sum()))
print("  overlapping IFT80 contact set:", sorted(set(hi.pos)&ift80))

ca=read_pdb_atoms("structures/AF_DYF3_Q6I6D4.pdb"); ca=ca[ca.name=="CA"].sort_values("resi")
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1, figsize=(12,8), gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[1.4,1,1], hspace=0.55))

ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(d.pos, 100*d["cons"], lw=0.8, color="0.45")
ax.plot(d.pos, 100*pd.Series(d["cons"]).rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(), lw=1.8, color="#1f4e79")
ax.axvspan(1,115,color="#7fb3d5",alpha=.25); ax.axvspan(160,300,color="#f0b27a",alpha=.25); ax.axvspan(301,404,color="0.85",alpha=.6)
for x in sorted(ift80): ax.plot([x,x],[-7,-2], color="#c0392b", lw=1.6)
ax.set_ylim(-9,105)
ax.text(57,98,"CH-like",ha="center",fontsize=9); ax.text(230,98,"coiled coil",ha="center",fontsize=9); ax.text(352,98,"acidic tail",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.text(410,-5,"IFT80 contacts",color="#c0392b",fontsize=8,va="center")
ax.set_xlabel("C. elegans DYF-3 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("% identity across\n18 orthologues")
ax.set_title("A  Per-residue conservation of DYF-3 across ciliated eukaryotes (red ticks: residues mapping to the IFT38-IFT80 interface in 8BD7)",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
ax.set_xlim(0,460)

ax=axes[1]
reg={"CH-like\n1-115":(1,115),"linker\n116-159":(116,159),"coiled coil\n160-300":(160,300),"acidic tail\n301-404":(301,404)}
vals=[100*d[(d.pos>=a)&(d.pos<=b)]["cons"].mean() for a,b in reg.values()]
ax.bar(range(4), vals, color=["#7fb3d5","0.7","#f0b27a","0.85"], edgecolor="k", lw=0.6)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+1, f"{v:.1f}%", ha="center", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(4)); ax.set_xticklabels(reg.keys(), fontsize=8.5); ax.set_ylabel("mean % identity")
ax.set_title("B  The CH-like domain is the most conserved part of DYF-3",fontsize=9.5,loc="left"); ax.set_ylim(0,65)

ax=axes[2]
rows=[]
folded=d[(d.pos<=300)]
for _,r in tab.iterrows():
    s=set(r.DYF3_res); a=folded[folded.pos.isin(s)]["cons"].dropna(); b=folded[~folded.pos.isin(s)]["cons"].dropna()
    rows.append((r.partner, 100*a.mean(), mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")[1]))
rows.sort(key=lambda x:-x[1])
ax.bar(range(len(rows)), [r[1] for r in rows], color=["#c0392b" if r[2]<0.05 else "0.65" for r in rows], edgecolor="k", lw=0.6)
ax.axhline(100*folded["cons"].mean(), ls="--", color="k", lw=1)
ax.text(len(rows)-0.4, 100*folded["cons"].mean()+1.5, f"folded region mean {100*folded['cons'].mean():.1f}%", ha="right", fontsize=7.5)
for i,r in enumerate(rows): ax.text(i, r[1]+1, f"p={r[2]:.3g}", ha="center", fontsize=7)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(rows))); ax.set_xticklabels([r[0] for r in rows], rotation=20, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("mean % identity\nat interface residues"); ax.set_ylim(0,72)
ax.set_title("C  Only the IFT80 interface is more conserved than the rest of the folded protein (Mann-Whitney, one-sided)",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
plt.show()
pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["partner","mean_pct_identity_18sp","MWU_p_greater"]).to_csv("interface_conservation_18species.csv", index=False)
